Sourdough starter notes

Feed the starter equal weights of flour and water every twelve hours at room temperature. A starter is ready to bake with when it doubles within four to six hours of feeding. Bulk fermentation at 78F takes about five hours; shape, then cold retard in the fridge overnight. Bake at 500F in a covered dutch oven for twenty minutes, then uncovered at 450F for twenty five minutes. Let the loaf cool fully before slicing or the crumb will be gummy.
